text:
Type: flatwoven area rug
Use: covering a dining or seating area; dining room, living room, kitchen
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, coastal
Materials: tight synthetic-look flat weave, fine basket-weave texture
Colors: light beige, sand, off-white flecks
Shape: rectangle with small checked weave texture, thin flat profile, plain edges, medium-large, light visual weight
Feel: neutral, calm, practical, airy
Goes with: light wood, white walls, rattan, natural linen; Scandinavian, coastal or Japandi dining and living rooms

product.name: MORUM
product.description: Ideal in your living room or under your dining table since the flat-woven surface makes it easy to pull out the chairs and vacuum.
